$comment: Option C (#48): AMQ on SNOs via isolated ACM policies. ApplicationSet and ztp-policies stay unbound. Hub spoke brokers unchanged. No SNO-to-hub AMQP federation (no hub AMQP route when tls is off).

covers.declared: Isolated edge-broker-policies: ManagedClusterSetBinding, AMQ operator ConfigurationPolicy, one ActiveMQArtemis policy per edgeBrokers region. ApplicationSet remains unbound.
covers.uncovered: SNO-to-hub AMQP federation and Module 3-5 retargeting (hub in-cluster producer URL stays). Binding ztp-policies / ApplicationSet children is option A/B/D, not C.
